This gives a complete natural family classification, identifies a projective wreath-product symmetry, an exact finite-field count with isolated binary rank-two rigidity, and a sharp three-point transition. The precise invariant is all set maps locally compatible with algebra automorphisms, not an arbitrary slice or ordinary GL recount.
